description: US · Manufacturing · pencoproducts.com Penco Products US metal manufacturer founded in 1869, now based in Greenville, North Carolina, making steel lockers, shelving, pallet racks and garment dispensers at its 375,000 square foot ISO certified plant in Hamilton.
